location_address: 1617 Quivira Rd San Diego, CA US 92109
description:
With a 6-passenger limit on every public tour, we are committed to giving you the very best, intimate whale watching experience available in San Diego! We cover the most ocean on a 2.5 hour trip of any offering in San Diego, giving you the very best odds to encounter whales and dolphins on your tour!

For private charters please call us to book!

If you’d like to leave a gratuity for the crew at the end of your trip, cash is strongly preferred due to the new regulations around venmo!
what_is_included: - The tour includes a approx. 2.5-hour, small-group whale-watching excursion aboard San Diego’s most far-ranging boats, maximizing your odds of intimate encounters with whales and dolphins.
check_in_details: We will embark on a 2-2.5hr (usually shorter in the winter and longer in the spring-fall) whale watching adventure from the dock located directly in front of Sportsmen's Seafood. The address is 1617 Quivira Rd, San Diego, CA 92109, USA. During our trip you will have the best chance available in San Diego to spot dolphins, whales, and any other marine life swimming in the open ocean.
what_to_bring: DRESS WARM NO MATTER THE WEATHER, MANY LAYERS REQUIRED, EVEN IN SUMMER! Our crew always wears a winter jacket, even in July when its 80+ degrees on land.
restrictions: Please note our vessels are extremely fast and can encounter the occasional bump on the open ocean. For this reason, we do not recommend these trips for anybody with back or neck problems. We also do not allow children under 5 years of age, passengers that are pregnant, or passengers that are unable to board and exit the vessel without assistance (call for further clarification). You assume all risk and release Gone Whale Watching Inc. of any liability by boarding our vessels.
